evals.prompt: How do I run lint checks on just one file `flext-core/src/flext_core/models.py`?
evals.expected_output: Use `ruff check flext-core/src/flext_core/models.py` or `make check FILE=flext-core/src/flext_core/models.py`. RTK intercepts bare commands automatically so never use `.venv/bin/ruff`.
assertions: mentions RTK interception or RTK proxy

evals.prompt: I changed something in flext-ldif. How do I run just its type checks?
evals.expected_output: Run `pyrefly check flext-ldif/src/` or `pyright flext-ldif/src/` directly. RTK proxies these for token savings. Alternatively use `make check PROJECT=flext-ldif CHECK_GATES=pyrefly`.
assertions: mentions `pyrefly check` or `pyright` with the project path

evals.prompt: Run only tests matching `test_parse` in flext-ldif, stopping on first failure.
evals.expected_output: Use `pytest flext-ldif/tests/ -k test_parse -x` or `make test PROJECT=flext-ldif MATCH=test_parse FAIL_FAST=1`.
assertions: mentions both direct pytest and make test approaches
